flashcards.q: How is indicative mood used in Portuguese?
flashcards.a: Many learners confuse the subjunctive with the indicative mood, leading to errors such as using the indicative "ele vai" (he goes) instead of the subjunctive "ele vá" (that he go) in sentences like "Eu quero que ele vá" (I want him to go).

flashcards.q: What is number?
flashcards.a: Number refers to whether the noun is singular or plural, gender refers to whether the noun is masculine or feminine, and case refers to the grammatical function of the noun in a sentence.
